title: Refit the Toshiba microwave roller carrier and keyed glass turntable

importance.person: Household microwave user reinstalling washed accessories or setting up the oven.
importance.workflow: Toshiba ML2-EC09SAIT(BS), EN16/PDF19, explicitly requires the carrier and correctly engaged glass tray before use.
importance.consequence: Restores stable rotating food support; a tray riding on its drive features is not correctly installed.
importance.objection: Kitchen reassembly could be another keyed nesting task like the accepted gas burner.
importance.resolved: Partly: the essential additional interface is an underside driven tray supported on three freely rolling wheels. Preserve engagement and free rotation, rather than merely stacking two parts.

sources.status: Original branded manufacturer PDF independently read from attributed mirror; assembly illustration visually inspected. Not independently authenticated against live Toshiba site.

hardware.product: Toshiba ML2-EC09SAIT(BS); retain the pictured triangular three-arm carrier, not a generic circular ring.
hardware.components: Original glass tray, three-wheel carrier, drive coupler/shaft, actual floor recess, door opening and nearby cavity walls; cold and unplugged.
hardware.material_size: Glass tray and molded carrier/wheels are pictured; manual does not specify material grades, tray diameter, hub section, wheel diameter, cavity access dimensions or masses. Numerical sizes in a future screen must be explicit parameters or measured source-asset values, never OEM claims.
hardware.initial: Carrier and tray separated on a draining mat; drive coupler remains installed; open door at its normal stop. Housing fixed on normal counter.
hardware.mating_retention: Carrier goes in floor recess; tray underside three-lug form engages drive and rests on rollers. Gravity retains accessories; no latch or magnet is invented.
hardware.tools_fixture: No installation tool; ordinary non-slip mat. One hand can steady the door/tray edge while the other guides the accessory. No enlarged handles.
hardware.known_unknown: Order and topology are verified. Essential contact dimensions and actual cavity/palm corridor require a declared representative-geometry screen; exact OEM manufacturing CAD is not required to test this topology.

starting_state: Cold oven with normal door open; tray and three-arm roller carrier uninstalled, authentic drive shaft still in floor.
instruction: Put the roller carrier in its recess and fit the glass tray right way up, correctly engaged on the drive and supported on all three rollers. Leave it free to turn with both hands clear.
essential_skill: Blind underside rotational registration while simultaneously landing a broad thin glass plate on a rolling support inside a real cavity.
bimanual_challenge: A tray wider than the94mm gripper aperture needs a rim pinch or two-hand edge support. The receiving aperture, door edge, wrist and second arm constrain the landing and withdrawal. Exact size/mass and stable purchase remain unverified.

physical_scoring.partial: 0.25 carrier correctly in recess, all wheels supported and free;0.5 tray right way up and supported but driven-hub registration incomplete. Only stable released endpoints count.
physical_scoring.full: Correct underside hub engagement, all three rollers loaded, no rocking, no wall/door interference, and a complete gentle manual turn without displaced carrier or slip at the hub. Hands clear before inspection.
physical_scoring.measurement: Depth/rim-height and wobble checks at three azimuths, photos of carrier/tray orientation and inspection of hub witness marks using macro/mirror access or a documented post-trial vertical-lift audit. Validate visibility on the selected geometry; if the hub cannot be independently inspected, do not substitute a hidden installed flag. A separate low-speed drive-only bench test may verify transmission if safely instrumented; no heating is part of the task.
physical_scoring.invalid: Cracked/chipped glass, broken wheel, missing carrier, upside-down tray, unsupported external prop or held tray earns0.
physical_scoring.reset: Lift tray by rim, remove carrier, inspect glass/wheels/coupler and return both to mat. No consumables.

wrong_solutions.solution: Tray rests directly on floor with carrier omitted
wrong_solutions.prevention: Carrier inventory, installed height and three-point support inspection.

wrong_solutions.solution: Tray rides on top of hub lugs at wrong phase
wrong_solutions.prevention: Hub registration, height/wobble and slip checks; proximity alone earns no full score.
Inspect correct face/underside orientation and actual mating.

wrong_solutions.solution: Robot supports tilted plate during inspection
wrong_solutions.prevention: Both hands withdrawn before released support/turn test.

closest_official_tasks.semantic_comparison: Gas-burner head slot around fixed igniter plus nested cap, neither locking nor driven. Same household reassembly setting and orientation/landing are material overlap. Proposed tray must add genuine hidden drive engagement plus roller support/free motion; different appliance alone is insufficient.

Keyed dog coupling with90degree transfer test. Legitimate drive-registration scope remains relevant; proposed broad glass-tray/support-ring/cavity handling differs, but function-test addition alone would not establish novelty.
Feed hex shaft through two fixed bearings with regrasp. No plate/carrier/cavity or underside coupling.

external_neighbors: RealAppliance039 inspected by independent critic:10 planning and15 continuation definitions cover food/heating controls, not accessory assembly. This is not a claim to clear every external benchmark.

verified: Manual original bytes and figure read
Actual accepted burner/shaft/bench-centre/U-joint task definitions and scoring source inspected
Exact external039 definitions inspected by critic
planning_only: Tray edge grasp, rim strength and full-YAM cavity clearance

remaining_uncertainty: Whether a full-scale tray edge can be acquired and landed with stock fingertips/palm clear of the cavity, and whether hub engagement is externally inspectable.
cheapest_falsifier: Parameterize only missing dimensions over a clearly labeled full-size range; use actual YAM315 hulls per arm and the real three-arm/hub topology to reject bad edge grasps and proud seating. Stop if all legitimate edge purchases collide or the hub cannot be measured without changing the hardware.
relative_effort: LOW–MEDIUM relative to portfolio: rigid contacts dominate; shallow keyed hub and free rollers must be preserved. No heating or deformable food simulation.

adversarial_strongest_rejection.objection: Another keyed kitchen nesting assembly already covered by#1990; simulation might hide wrong hub seating behind a generic ring.
adversarial_strongest_rejection.resolved: Not fully. The proposal is defensible only with the real rolling support and driven interface; first source-guided CPU test must keep these.

title: Install a loaded Hamilton Beach rotisserie spit into drive and cradle

importance.person: Household cook using the manufacturer Countertop Oven with Rotisserie guide.
importance.workflow: Original guide PDF11–12 explicitly describes preloading/trussing, fitting pointed right end to drive, then square left end into support slot.
importance.consequence: Supports and drives a loaded roast without dropping or striking heaters.
importance.objection: Rotisserie is a niche cooking setup; a domestic product cannot inherit commercial-cook employment.
importance.resolved: Unresolved relatability risk. Household-only warranty is disclosed; no jobs claim.

sources.status: Original branded Hamilton Beach PDF read from attributed mirror, installation illustration visually inspected. Exact donor SKU not identified in the document.

hardware.product: Hamilton Beach Countertop Oven with Rotisserie, exact pictured manual family; donor SKU remains the specific source gate.
hardware.components: Real full-width pointed/square-ended spit, two forks with clamping screws, pretrussed1.4kg roast, right drive socket, left slotted bracket, low drip pan and normal open oven door. Remove both racks per manual.
hardware.material_size: Metal rod/forks/oven; guide gives1.4–1.5kg pork/beef and2.3kg chicken examples, and at least25mm food-to-heater clearance. Rod length/cross-section, socket section/depth, cradle opening and cavity dimensions unmeasured.
hardware.initial: Roast correctly trussed and centered on real forks, fork screws already tight: this is a genuine installation substep, not a food-trussing task. Spit lies on a normal preparation tray; pan installed low.
hardware.mating_retention: Pointed RIGHT end inserted into real drive socket, rotate as necessary; square LEFT end rests in slotted bracket. No fabricated retractable support, removable oven wall or hidden attachment.
hardware.tools_fixture: Manual installation uses hands; ordinary supplied rotisserie lift is documented for removal, not assumed mandatory installation tool. Fixed counter supports oven.
hardware.known_unknown: Procedure/load roles clear; exact compatible donor oven/spit/socket section must be bound before claiming full-scale access.

starting_state: Cold unplugged oven with racks removed and drip pan low; preloaded1.4kg spit assembly outside oven.
instruction: Fit the loaded spit into the right-hand drive, rotating it as needed to engage, then lower its left square end into the bracket. Leave it supported and free to rotate, with hands clear.
essential_skill: Acquire and control a long heavy eccentric load while engaging one constrained drive end and bringing its other end into an open support without losing the first engagement.
bimanual_challenge: Both hands may be required for the1.4kg assembly and its moment; the right wrist must enter near the wall, then left end must lower without glass/door/heater collision. Do not replace loaded spit by an empty lightweight rod.

physical_scoring.partial: 0.25 right drive genuinely acquired while load supported;0.5 both real supports acquired but not fully seated. Only final safe stable states receive endpoint credit; unstable hand-supported partial is explicitly capped.
physical_scoring.full: Both ends seated at source-compatible depth/height, forks retain roast, hands clear, no contact with pan/heaters, at least25mm food/heater clearance, and a full slow drive-only revolution without slipping, lifting out or striking cavity. No heating.
physical_scoring.measurement: End-socket seating photo/inspection, support shoulder gap, ruler for25mm clearance, visible drive/spit witness marks under a low-speed mechanical drive-only test. Proposed angular slip/seat-gap limits require calibration on selected donor; none is claimed OEM.
physical_scoring.invalid: Dropped load, loosened fork, damaged glass, wall collision, external prop/third hand or relocated socket invalidates.
physical_scoring.reset: Use documented lift to raise and slide left, remove assembly; inspect forks/support and restore original prepared state. Roast may be a disclosed rigid mass/collision proxy because food deformation/trussing are outside the scoped installation, with correct mass/clearance envelope preserved.

wrong_solutions.solution: Balance rod on both bracket lips without right drive engagement
wrong_solutions.prevention: Witness-mark drive transfer and seated end-depth inspection.

wrong_solutions.solution: Use an empty short rod or omit the roast
wrong_solutions.prevention: Source-compatible loaded mass/envelope is part of initial inventory and score.

wrong_solutions.solution: Hold free end with robot while drive spins
wrong_solutions.prevention: Released support state and full hands-clear revolution.
Full-turn collision and25mm source clearance check.

closest_official_tasks.semantic_comparison: Two pointed bench centres, spring retraction lever and shaft swing; no driven end or loaded spit/cavity. Shared two-end acquisition is material but not automatically duplication.
U-joint cross overtravels one closed ear and swings into opposite ear. Real sequence overlap exists; no remote open cradle, loaded food or driven endpoint.
Long hex shaft feeds through two bearings. No open-side cradle lowering or loaded cavity support.

external_neighbors: Independent RealAppliance055 audit:10 plans and13 continuation records, including rotisserie function selection, but none installs the spit/drive/bracket. The earlier source record020 is unrelated and not used.

verified: Original procedure, image and load/clearance examples
Actual accepted shaft-between-centres/U-joint/feed-shaft definitions and source read
Current rotisserie synonym search and external055 task definitions
planning_only: Stable stock-YAM grasp and load torque

hard_blockers: Exact compatible donor oven/spit interface dimensions have not been bound.
remaining_uncertainty: One matched donor/SKU geometry package for the pictured drive, spit, cradle and cavity; this is not permission to invent a retractable socket.
cheapest_falsifier: One matched dimensioned donor drawing or defensibly scaled registered image set, then full-YAM loaded-spit insertion sweep. Reject if proper two-hand support cannot keep25mm clearance or acquire both genuine supports.
relative_effort: MEDIUM if matched donor recovered; otherwise no further speculative model. Load and cavity access dominate, not body count.

adversarial_strongest_rejection.objection: Niche household reassembly and a loaded two-ended shaft may merely repeat existing shaft installation, while the model deletes the oven/load.

specific_source_issue: One matched donor oven/spit/drive/cradle geometry definition, including exact product identity.
